root: ^Bram rests his hammer beside the anvil. "Let the steel do its work. You look after the edge."

c-0: ^"One gold for each missing point of durability. A weapon starts at twenty and wears by one for each attack. At zero, its weapon power is halved."
c-1: ^"Swords, wands and paired guns suit every race. Humans and Elves can equip bows; Giants can own them, but cannot equip them. No ammunition is needed yet."
c-2: ^"Your bare hands still work. Change equipment in town before you leave; a dungeon run keeps the setup you entered with."
